text: Magister Dignitary's Tunic is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Magister Dignitary's Trappings.
Magister's Bookshelf is housing decor that drops as bonus loot from Degentrius in Magisters' Terrace.
Magister's Summons is available on the weekly reset if the player has not completed the Omnium Folio questline.

Magister's Cleaver is made with Midnight Blacksmithing. The recipe is automatically learned upon unlocking the Axes and Polearms subspecialization (Weaponsmithing ⮞ Hafted Weapons ⮞ Axes and Polearms). It can also be learned from Plans: Magister's Cleaver.

Magister's Mana Sword is made with Midnight Blacksmithing. The recipe is automatically learned upon unlocking the Long Blades subspecialization (Weaponsmithing ⮞ Blades ⮞ Long Blades). It can also be learned from Plans: Magister's Mana Sword.

Magister's Ritual Knife is made with Midnight Blacksmithing. The recipe is automatically learned upon unlocking the Short Blades subspecialization (Weaponsmithing ⮞ Blades ⮞ Short Blades). It can also be learned from Plans: Magister's Ritual Knife.
Magister's Valediction is made with Midnight Blacksmithing (50); taught by Plans: Magister's Valediction.

Magister's Grand Focus is created with Midnight Enchanting. The recipe is automatically learned upon unlocking the Worthy Wands subspecialization (Transitories, Tonics, and Tools ⮞ Outstanding Outfits ⮞ Worthy Wands).
Magnificent Towering Bookcase is housing decor created with Midnight Inscription (50); taught by Technique: Magnificent Towering Bookcase.
Magma Soldiers are fire furies summoned by Molten Generals at the end of Dreamsurge portal events on the Dragon Isles.
Magisters of Logistics are blood elves located throughout Eversong Woods.
Magmatus is the second boss in the Hall of Thanes instance, found at the Dark Iron Ingress. It is accompanied by a Dark Iron Summoner.
Major Firestones are created with a warlock's Create Firestone (Major) spell in Classic, or with Create Firestone (Rank 4) in BC Classic and Wrath Classic.
Makeshift Beaded Bracelet drops from Doomshadow in the Azure Span.
Mahaja Cloudsong is a tauren located at the Gala of Gifts in Durotar during Love is in the Air.
Majordomo's Drape is contained in the Cache of the Firelord after defeating in the .
Makeshift South Sea Oar is sold by Pix Xizzix in Booty Bay for .
The Maiden's Whisper was a Kul Tiran ship that sailed to the Siren Isle but was caught in storm. Its surviving crew went missing.
Magsy Bootstrap is a goblin located at Venturewood in the Undermine.
Makha's Shield is found next to Makha's Sword at the Northern Rampart in Hellfire Peninsula. It belonged to Scout Makha.
Makha's Sword is found next to Makha's Shield at the Northern Rampart in Hellfire Peninsula. It belonged to Scout Makha.

Mail Overflow is found at outside The P.O.S.T. in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. Interacting with it applies the buff. Enter the P.O.S.T. and stand in the targeted area near Delivery Portals and activate the Distribute Mail extra action button four times, which grants access to the Mailroom Distribution chest. : :

Mailroom Distribution is a chest found at inside the P.O.S.T. in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market after delivering Mail Overflow. It contains the P.O.S.T. Master's Express Hearthstone toy and looting it is one of the criteria of Treasures of K'aresh. When approaching it: : :

The Maisara Caverns is a dungeon in . It will have adventurers rescue the Witherbark trolls from the Vilebranch trolls. Unlocking the dungeon is done by reaching level 85 or completing the Maisara Caverns: Maisara Hungers quest.
Make Haste, Not Waste is a daily quest given by Lidamorrutu at the Infinite Bazaar south of Dalaran during Legion Remix that awards a random piece of Remix jewelry.
Magtheridon's Lair Reforged is an achievement earned for defeating Magtheridon in Magtheridon's Lair on Titan Reforged.

The Majestic Meeksi Collection is a collection of all the meeksi mounts for Classic (progression branch only), each available for purchase separately for $25 USD. This collection brings these mounts to the Classic setting for the first time. This collection was released on 16 December 2025 with no end date listed.
__NOTOC__ Majestic Hide is a hide crafting reagent obtained by players with the Skinning profession.
__NOTOC__ Majestic Claw is a crafting reagent obtained by players with the Skinning profession.
__NOTOC__ Majestic Fin is a crafting reagent obtained by players with the Skinning profession.
Making a Deposit are weekly quest, that can be started through Crystallised Anima and handed in to Ve'nari at the Oasis for 20% progress on the Ecological Succession (world quest).
Mak'rana Hardshells are makrura found at the Shipwreck Shoals in the Eye of Azshara dungeon.
Mahogany Dye was a housing dye used to color certain housing decor. It could be crafted by alchemists or scribes via Dye Crafting with 1 Red Dye Pigment.
Mail of Darkened Deceit is a quest reward from A Final Destination.

Majestic Lightwood Table is housing decor obtained from the quest The First to Know. Additional copies can be purchased for 500 Voidlight Marl from Sathren Azuredawn at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.

Majestic Eagle Statues are obtained from the Bag of Totally Legitimate Amani Goods during the Knock-off Amani endeavor. It can be traded with Shon'ja in Razorwind Shores or Faarden the Builder in Founder's Point via the Majestic Eagle Statue (quest) quest for a Neighborhood Knick Knack.

Frames can be made scrollable by using a combination of a scroll box, scroll bar, and a scroll view. There are a few different types of scrollable frames including list views, tree views, content views, and grid views. These can be created either through Lua, or through XML.
Makrura Leg drops from Makrura Clackers, Snappers, and Shellhides off the coast of . It can be used with the Ominous Tome (Durotar) in order to summon Soboz on the Echo Isles.
Makir is an earthen located in the Forgegrounds in Dornogal.
Maldraxxi Gladiators are abominations located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Making Scents is a Sniffenseek dig adventure started with Myrrit in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern.
Makrura's Foreboding Legplates drop from Murkspike at Bleak Sand in Hallowfall.
Makuna Hatada is an ally card from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.

__NOTOC__ Malevolent Gladiator's Plate Armor is a collection of plate transmog sets for Warriors. They collect the appearances of the warrior Season 12 armor, along with additional items that match visually but do not grant set bonuses. Collecting either set will grant the Why Male(volent) Models? achievement.
Malanore is a voidstalker found sleeping next to Voidtamer Harpra in Shan'dorah in K'aresh.

Makko's Journal Cover has a chance to drop from the following gorlocs in the Ohn'ahran Plains: *Captivated Shellwarden *Enthralled Shellcracker *Enraptured Hunter *Beguiled Aquamancer *Mesmerized Healer
Making an Amani Out of You is a quest achievement earned by completing the listed Zul'Aman achievements.
Malaxxar the Frustrated is a fel lord located at the Infinite Bazaar south of Dalaran. He is chained up and serves as a training dummy.
Malevolent Conquest is a PvP achievement earned for collecting 27,000 Conquest Points during Season 12.
Maku is a haranir located in the Den in Harandar. He sells housing decor in exchange for Voidlight Marl.
Maldraxxi Shieldguards are Maldraxxi abominations found guarding the Necrotic Bulwarks at the Temple of Courage in Bastion during Death Rains, No Hesitation, No Surrender, and Peace by Piece.
Maldraxxian Crate is housing decor created with Shadowlands Leatherworking (80); taught by Hildir in Maldraxxus and Tanner Au'qil in Oribos.
Maldraxxian Runic Tablet is housing decor created with Shadowlands Jewelcrafting (80); taught by Appraiser Au'vesk in Oribos.
Malefic Venom is created by interacting with the Venom Fountain in the Vault of Restless Bones or the Venomfall Font in the Profaned Mausoleum in the Vaults of Atal'Utek in the Coiled Isle.

Malevolent Fishing Codex can be fished from an Abyssal Swirl on the Coiled Isle after both becoming Bloodsworn Crew in the eyes of Captain Tokka and assisting the Three-Eyed Fish. It begins the quest Cursed Fishing 101. It cannot be fished up while on any of the Three-Eyed Fish's quests.
Malduko Cloudcrush is a skyborne found at Thendal Grove on Zephras Isle.
Malar Silverfrost is an ally card from the Throne of the Tides set.
Malor the Zealous is an elite human found in the Scarlet Bastion in . He is described as a crazed member of the Scarlet Crusade and guards Malor's Strongbox containing the Medallion of Faith.
Mallard Mortar is created with Engineering (50); taught by Schematic: Mallard Mortar.
Malisia is a green dragonspawn vendor located in the Eye of Ysera in the Emerald Dream.
Mammyth is a Dream-infused magmammoth mount that can be purchased for from Elianna in the Emerald Dream after obtaining any other magmammoth mount.
Mallard Duckling is a duckling companion that can be purchased for from Pakak at the Artisan's Market in Valdrakken.
Mammoth-Tamer Tavok is a djaradin located at Emberflow in the Waking Shores.
Malfunctioning Robotic Cauldrons are cook-o-trons located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.
Man'ari Acolytes are man'ari eredar located at the Grove of Naroua in Krokuun.
Man'ari Sycophants are man'ari eredar located at the Grove of Naroua in Krokuun.
Malsegan is an armoredon located at the Watering Hole in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Malevolent Pie can be purchased from Greishan Ironstove in for . Eating it gives the Hellish Indigestion debuff, which will grant the Rune of Channeling when it expires.
Malformed Sha are sha located in the Temple of the Jade Serpent.
Mallard Duck Disguise adds a transformation for the Duck Disguiser.
Malukh is an earthen located in the Forgegrounds in Dornogal.
Malformed Squirrels are squirrels located throughout Bloodmyst Isle before the Tishamaat.
Malevolent Prophet's Leggings are sold by Zalgo the Explorer for .
Malevolent Prophet's Vestments is a cloth set sold by Zalgo the Explorer.
Malevolent Prophet's Sandals are sold by Zalgo the Explorer for .
Malevolent Prophet's Vest is sold by Zalgo the Explorer for .
Malkorok's Giant Stompers drop from Malkorok in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Malkorok's Tainted Dog Tags drop from Malkorok in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Malkorok's Skullcleaver drops from Malkorok in the Siege of Orgrimmar.
Malleable Protection is a Paladin rune for belts. It is learned from Rune of Piety.
The Malfunctioning Spire is a crystal elemental located at the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn.
Maluc is an earthen located in Freywold Village on the Isle of Dorn.
Malfunctioning Defense Turrets are cogwalkers that have a chance to appear when collecting Odd Glob of Wax and launch a cone of fire at the adventurers direction.

Malfunctioning Mechsuit drops from Void Speaker Eirich in the Stonevault on mythic difficulty. It begins A Mech in Need, a short warband-wide quest line that eventually rewards the Stonevault Mechsuit. To finish the questline, players must loot the Overclocked Gear-a-Rang Launcher from Speaker Dorlita in the Stonevault, the Synergistic Brewterializer from Goldie Baronbottom in the Cinderbrew Meadery, and Burin of the Candle King from The Candle King in Darkflame Cleft.
Malfunctioning Railbots are haulbots located at the Ironhaul Station in the Ringing Deeps.
The Malfunctioning Resonance Crystal is found at the Elodor Dig in .
Malfunctioning Pylons are located in the Ritual Hall in the Hall of Awakening during the Awakening the Machine event.
Mammoth Carcasses can be created by applying a U.D.E.D. to one of the Ironwool Mammoths in the Snowblind Hills in the Storm Peaks.
Mammoth Meat can be created by applying a U.D.E.D. to one of the Ironwool Mammoths in the Snowblind Hills in the Storm Peaks.
Mana-Craving Felhunters are felhounds that can be found in the Isle of Dorn in A Helping Hand quest if the player pulls it from the purple unstable portal.
Malfunctioning Cratemover is a goblin drone located in the Castaway Cove in the Undermine.
Malfunctioning Protectors are stone golems located in Thaldraszus.
Mama Keara is a goblin located in the Barrelbottom Apartments in the Undermine.

The cosmetic version is sold by Torie south of the Coreway in Dornogal for 400 Displaced Corrupted Mementos after completing the achievement We Have the Memories.

Manaforge Omega is the third and final raid of , added in patch 11.2.0 as part of The War Within Season 3. It is located on K'aresh at Shadow Point in the northwestern corner of the zone.
Manaforge Omega Guild Run is awarded to players who defeated all bosses in Manaforge Omega on Normal or higher difficulties in a guild group.
Manaforge Vandals are the renown faction associated with the Manaforge Omega raid, much like the Gallagio Loyalty Rewards Club in Liberation of Undermine.
Manaforged Displacement Chassis drops from the Plexus Sentinel in Manaforge Omega.

__NOTOC__ Mana-Tinted Glasses is a curio for Brann Bronzebeard during The War Within Season 3. The baseline version is found in low-tier delves, and higher-rank versions are found in higher-tier delves, all the way up to the Rank 4 version in Tier 8 delves.

Manaforge Omega: Dimensius Looms begins the final chapter of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign, The Light of K'aresh. This quest requires a visit to Manaforge Omega, which opened up the week of 12 August 2025. If completing the raid on any regular difficulty is not in the cards, Story Mode is available and opened the week of 19 August 2025.

Mandatory Time Off begins the optional "On a Technicality" chapter of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign alongside Overwhelm Them. Find Associate Xy'nell outside the Xy Imports Offices in northeastern Tazavesh to begin. This chapter awards 500 reputation with the K'aresh Trust and Explorer 1 legs. Both of these quests are revisited in the world quest Overwhelm Them with Mandatory Time Off.
Mana-Vent Aphis is the first exhaust tower attached to the Technomancers' Terrace.
Mana-Vent Batar is the second exhaust tower attached to the Technomancers' Terrace.

Mana-Seamster's Arcane-Needle can drop from season-specific sources in delves. During The War Within Season 3, it had a chance to drop from the Shadowed Flickering Spoils which spawns in the treasure room after successfully defeating a Ky'veza's Shadow Clone (one of the few things that can spawn from a Flickergate). It can also drop from a Hidden Trove, the Great Vault, or the Cache of Delver's Spoils.

Mana-Fortified Vintages are bottles of wine located on the ground around near an overturned wagon at the end of a bridge in Eversong Woods. Apprentince Ralien claims the wine attacked him when approached. This claim appears to be true, as Wine Droplets will sometimes spawn as the wine bottles are collected. The item flavor text mentions it being bottled early during Anasterian Sunstrider's reign, and since the High King of Quel'thalas ruled for over 2,800 years, it is indeed quite old.
